headline: THE 355 COMANCHE VERDICT LANDED AT 3:13 THIS AFTERNOON AND IT IS A NO — but the part that matters is what the agent DIDN'T write: for the fourth read running, both price fields were left completely blank, which means nobody is telling you the number is wrong anymore, they are just not saying anything.

hotSignals.signal: STILL THE ONLY UNQUALIFIED YES ON THE BOARD, AND IT IS NOW SIX DAYS OLD. Mallory W. · ARC Realty filed the only 'interested: YES' with 'priced: JUST RIGHT' anywhere in the fourteen-day window — her buyer wants to write and is short on down payment, nothing else. She then texted you directly on Thursday afternoon asking the age of the HVAC because she could not find it on MLS, which is a buyer's agent doing diligence homework, not a courtesy note. ⭐ A showing also ran on this unit at 6:00 this evening, so a second read may land tomorrow.
hotSignals.action: Call her — she is a p1 on your board and the phone is the only door open, since agent outreach is suspended by your own August 4 ruling. Answer the HVAC question in the same call, and ask your seller for a concession number before it, so you have something to trade.

hotSignals.signal: The other standing 'interested: YES' on the board — filed at $299,000 with 'priced: TOO HIGH' attached. That buyer's objection was answered five days ago when the price came down to $295,000, and nothing has gone back to the agent to say so.
hotSignals.action: One line to that agent: the price moved to $295,000 on the exact objection they raised. It is the cheapest re-open available on this listing.

listings.note: ⛔ THE PRICE-QUOTE RULE ON THIS FILE IS UNCHANGED AND IT MATTERS: quote $295,000 and nothing else. Across four written reads and one agent preview, not a single agent has ever put a different number on paper — every 'what price' field is empty. There is no market-supported replacement price to quote, so quoting one would be inventing it. ⭐ WHAT THE PATTERN ACTUALLY SUGGESTS: three reads called the number too high at $299,000; since the cut to $295,000, the two reads that followed stopped saying it. That points away from price and toward photos, staging and story — and the staging 3 today is the only concrete score anyone has left you. ✅ Monday 1:40 PM is the tiebreaker.
